summary: Vehicle drove into Lake Loveland at Colorado Ave and Eisenhower Blvd and submerged about 75 yards offshore; the driver was freed by civilian bystanders; Loveland Fire Dive 2, the Larimer County Sheriff Dive Rescue Team and Berthoud Dive searched the submerged vehicle and swept the lake bed for a reported second occupant (none existed — located elsewhere unharmed); three people treated for cold-water exposure; vehicle recovered for tow.
responding_agency: Loveland Fire Rescue Authority; Larimer County Sheriff Dive Rescue Team
notes: Included per the id-3817 Horsetooth dive-recovery precedent: the Larimer County Sheriff Dive Rescue Team operation (submerged-vehicle search + lake-bed sweep for a reported second occupant) is the SAR element; driver freed by civilian bystanders before dive teams arrived; reported second occupant located elsewhere unharmed, never at the scene; 3 people treated for cold-water exposure (driver + 2 civilian rescuers); Nov 28, 2015 was a Saturday.
